text:
Alina (Partnerships): Hey team — kicking off coordination for UK-South2 marketplace + capacity launch. Partners: AWS Marketplace listing + Nvidia partner to get A100 pooled capacity in region. Target go-live window: 2024-06-10 to 2024-06-14. Need: quota approvals, marketplace entitlements, joint announcement signoff, and an RT ticket for reserved capacity. Who can own which parts?

Ben (Cloud Ops): I can own quota requests and the reserved capacity RT. Need exact SKU and estimated baseline QPS + token throughput to size pools. Can you confirm expected peak concurrent streams?

Alina (Partnerships): Peak concurrent streams ~80 for the first 30d, then we expect linear ramp. Baseline token throughput ~120M tokens/day. SKU: aws.a100-80g. Will validate with Nvidia partner for pooled entitlement.

Nate (Partner Eng): I’ll handle marketplace entitlement wiring and the marketplace listing checklist. Also will validate that our runtime image passes AWS Marketplace packaging tests (billing ID, product code). ETA: I can get a draft listing + dev account test by 2024-05-20.

Carla (Legal): Heads up — joint announcement + partner logos need partner signoff and trademark checks. I need partner logo artifacts and a copy of the joint press blurb 7 business days before publish. If announcement is within that 2024-06-10 window, we need final copy by 2024-06-01.

Devon (Sales): We need sales enablement (1-pager + pricing matrix + FAQ). If legal needs final copy by 06-01, can partnerships provide the 1-pager draft by 05-24? I’ll run training for EU field on 06-05.

Alina (Partnerships): Yep — I’ll produce a draft 1-pager and joint blurb by 05-22. Nate, can you confirm the marketplace product code placeholder so Ben can request quota against the correct identifier?

Nate (Partner Eng): Placeholder product code: rwinf-uk-south2-a100-v1 (final will be assigned by AWS). I’ll add it to the marketplace checklist doc and ping the AWS listing team.

Ben (Cloud Ops): Thanks — I’ll open RT-4857 for reserved capacity request and put the placeholder product code in the ticket. Also tagging aws-bot to confirm region SKU availability.

aws-bot: AWS Inventory check OK: sku aws.a100-80g available in eu-west-3 and eu-west-2; UK-South2 availability pending partner allocation. Suggest requesting soft-reservation to hold capacity.

Nate (Partner Eng): Noted. I’ll coordinate with Nvidia contacts to confirm pooled capacity and timeline. If they need an LOI, let me know and I’ll draft.

Carla (Legal): LOI ok — send to legal@redwood for quick review. For marketplace T&Cs, we also need to confirm data residency language for UK customers.

Alina (Partnerships): Action items summary: 1) Ben opens quota/reservation RT (owner: Ben, RT-4857). 2) Nate owns marketplace listing + product code (owner: Nate). 3) Alina drafts 1-pager + joint blurb by 05-22. 4) Carla to review logos/press/legal by 06-01. 5) Devon to prepare sales training 06-05. Please react with :thumbsup: when you accept.

Devon (Sales): :thumbsup: accepted.

Ben (Cloud Ops): :thumbsup: opening RT now, ETA for initial reply 24h.

Nate (Partner Eng): :thumbsup: I’ll start the marketplace checklist and ping AWS listing team.

Carla (Legal): :thumbsup: will block review time on calendar.

Alina (Partnerships): Great — I’ll track these in the partnerships roadmap and set a daily standup for the week of 05-20 to keep momentum. If anyone hits blockers please post here.

Ben (Cloud Ops): Quick Q — are we planning canary traffic split for the first week? If yes, we should add the rollout policy to RT-4857.

Alina (Partnerships): Yes — plan is 10% traffic for first 48h then 50% for next 72h if SLOs are met. Add rollout policy note to the RT.

Nate (Partner Eng): I’ll add a note in the marketplace checklist to surface canary routing and fallback model variants.

Alina (Partnerships): Thanks team — closing initial thread. I’ll update with links to RT and marketplace doc in this thread once created.

(END)
